Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].cChildren As 'AddCalculatedMembers([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].currentmember.children).count' Set FilteredMembers As 'Head (Filter(AddCalculatedMembers([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Level 04].Members), InStr(1, [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].currentmember.member_caption, "J")>0),10001)' Select {[Measures].cChildren} on ROWS, Hierarchize(Generate(FilteredMembers, Ascendants([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].currentmember))) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME, MEMBER_TYPE ON COLUMNS FROM [ZCLVISIT]
